player_prompt.intro:
Ni Player {player_id} mu game ya Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; mwamoneni card ya opponent.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila round, {max_rounds} round(s) zote.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni integer chanya <= chip count yako.)
- Hidden card iliyo na thamani kubwa inashinda pot katika showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Takwaba ico mwingeta; kuti mwacita fye [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Mulebomfya [bet X] pa kuti mufungulule; tamwaba ukucishamo.
invalid_move.insufficient: Tawakwata ifisoso fya kukwanisha ukucite co.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: bonse {card}. Pot split  each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Ifisushi fyaba fye cimo cine panuma ya ma round yonse.
